answer: Sybil resistance here runs on a paid proof-of-liveness loop. Each agent identity must forge a bonded stake before transacting, and every round the network sends a fresh challenge pulse it must answer with work only a persistent, funded operator sustains. A fake cluster must stake every puppet separately and answer pulses in parallel, so cost scales linearly per fake identity instead of staying flat. A violet stamp from a bot farm stays worthless unless real peers attest it.
